title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Service Agent in Microsoft 365 as a dedicated service specialist
summary: Hold: the briefing describes administrator roles and tool-access controls as unpublished even though Microsoft documents general governance covering Microsoft-platform agents. Its statement that access scoping is undocumented also overlooks the published scope of the agent's own Microsoft 365 resources. The roadmap facts, Public Preview billing, and printed Block path and API are supported.
